component.name: Slumber
component.summary: Sleep and hibernate manager: save battery while your laptop sleeps

description.p: Slumber gives your Fedora laptop Windows-style sleep. It suspends instantly when you close the lid, then after a delay you choose it wakes briefly, saves everything to an encrypted swapfile and powers off completely, so a laptop left asleep overnight does not drain its battery.

ul.li: See hibernation status, swapfile, battery and the battery used by each sleep
Turn suspend-then-hibernate on or off from a simple form, with administrator approval
Keep the laptop awake after locking while a long task finishes, or hibernate right now
Optional: sleep shortly after locking, and stop USB devices from waking the laptop
A Keep Awake tile in the GNOME Quick Settings panel
